Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana killed in attack at crusher plant

Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana was killed in an attack at a crusher plant in Bharatpur, Rajasthan. Reports indicate that 70-80 people attacked the plant. The incident is reportedly linked to a dispute over a mining lease with villagers.
